_comment: Source registry for the Phase 2 build pipeline. License text is quoted verbatim from the URL in licenseVerifiedAt, checked on the date given. 01-download.mjs adds download date, byte size and sha256 to raw/_manifest.json; 08-report.mjs merges both into DATA_SOURCES.md (brief section 4).
datasetVersionNote: kaikki extraction date; upstream enwiktionary dump 2026-07-06. Bump this whenever the kaikki file is re-downloaded — it is the version the app shows in About and the directory name under public/dict/. A trailing -rN marks a rebuild from the SAME sources with different build logic; r2 made every conjugation table kaikki-derived, r3 added package-verified conjugation teaching patterns plus precomputed discovery families, and r4 enriches senses with relations, topics and Wiktionary examples while adding first-sentence etymology and dormant related-word data.

sources.name: Wiktionary Spanish entries (English Wiktionary) via kaikki.org / wiktextract
sources.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL (dual-licensed, inherited from English Wiktionary)
sources.licenseQuote: Text is available under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike License; additional terms may apply.
sources.attribution: Attribute English Wiktionary contributors; share-alike applies to derived text. Extraction tooling: wiktextract (Tatu Ylonen), served by kaikki.org.
sources.notes: kaikki's Spanish index page marks this postprocessed JSONL 'DEPRECATED' but still serves it; it is the only kaikki file with Spanish headwords and ENGLISH glosses as required by brief section 4. The downloads/es/ path is the SPANISH Wiktionary (Spanish glosses) and is NOT interchangeable.

recheck.why: Standing re-check (spike report, decision 2): confirm at each refresh whether kaikki still serves this file and still marks it deprecated.

sources.name: FrequencyWords Spanish frequency list (OpenSubtitles-derived)
sources.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (generated frequency lists; repository code is MIT)
sources.notes: TOKEN frequencies (surface forms), not lemma ranks. Brief section 12 requires form-to-lemma aggregation before these become lemma ranks; 03-frequency.mjs does it with the citation-form-first policy.

sources.name: Fred Jehle's Spanish Verb Database (600+ fully conjugated verbs)
sources.attribution: Fred Jehle, Indiana University-Purdue University Fort Wayne; compiled by ghidinelli.
sources.notes: NONCOMMERCIAL — and deliberately NOT DISTRIBUTED. As of dataset kaikki-es-2026-07-25-r2 this database is used only at build time, to validate the kaikki conjugation extractor cell by cell (99.83% agreement across 57,580 cells). No Jehle content appears in the shipped bundle, so its noncommercial terms do not attach to the distributed data. The CSV itself is never committed — raw/ is gitignored.
